title: Add "ID Curva" filter to Traços Corrigidos selector table (Corrigido tab)
body:
The "Traços corrigidos — selecione para as curvas" table had filters for nº traço/cliente/data, título, and tipo de cimento, but no way to filter by the **ID Curva** column — making it tedious to isolate rows when multiple curve IDs are present.

## Changes

- **HTML**: Added `abramsIdCurvaFilter` input ("Filtrar por ID Curva") in the filter bar, after the tipo de cimento filter and before the select/deselect buttons.
- **JS (`renderAbramsTraceSelector`)**: Added `idCurvaVal` read from the new input; filter resolves each item's curve ID via the same lookup already used at render time (`state.tracosSalvos` by `origemNum` → `curvaSecundariaId || curvaId`), then applies a case-insensitive `includes` match.
- **Event listener**: Wired `input` event on `abramsIdCurvaFilter` to `renderAbramsTraceSelector`, consistent with the other filters.
